body:
**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `1a35ba1`: all 10 files reviewed.

5 finding(s): 2 to fix, 3 to consider; 5 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 4.** Part 1 covers the new DestinationDetail and DestinationList components. One fix: in SizeBarCard, `role="img"` with a size-only aria-label hides the "% lighter" and GitHub 10 MB limit text from screen readers. One consider: the custom radio groups have no arrow-key navigation or roving tabindex.

**Batch 2 of 4.** I found two things worth a look in this part (prepare-page.tsx and its test), neither blocking:

- **Global Enter shortcut is too broad.** It is registered on `document`, so Enter pressed outside the Prepare screen can also start a copy. That includes Enter on non-native controls such as `div role="button"`, and Enter while the onboarding overlay is open over the page. The overlay's own handler sits on `window`, so it runs after this one and can't stop it.
- **Weak test.** The test for "Enter doesn't re-select the row" can't fail as written, because jsdom never fires the click a browser would.

The rest checks out:

- Defaulting to YouTube, including when `?to=` is unknown.
- Choosing between opening an existing copy and starting a new one.
- Keeping the latest action in a ref so the listener is added only once.
- The other tests, which match the new behaviour.

**Batch 3 of 4.** I found nothing to flag in the two new stylesheets in this part. I checked every class and data-attribute selector against destination-detail.tsx and destination-list.tsx: the components use each one, and the attribute values match what they render (data-group, data-direction, data-active, data-soft). Every custom property the stylesheets use is defined in packages/tokens/css/tokens.css or apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/assets/base.css, for both themes where the token differs.

**Batch 4 of 4.** Part 4 covers the trimmed `prepare-page.module.css`, the backlog doc and the en/es messages. The stylesheet now keeps only the classes `prepare-page.tsx` still uses: `screen`, `detail` and the state classes. Its 900 × 670 sizing note matches `createWindow` (`main/index.ts:265-266`) and the `main` preset's minimum (`shared/window-size.ts:50`). The doc's description of the two-column layout matches `destination-detail.tsx`. One issue: the new message key `sizeBarTitle` is not used by any code.
